items.item_text: Board certified or board eligible in Family Medicine, Internal Medicine or Medicine-Pediatrics
Unrestricted, California medical license or license eligible

Bring your expertise to UCLA Health and build a rewarding primary care practice supported by the resources, clinical excellence and reputation of one of the nation’s leading health systems. Ranked #1 in California and #1 in Los Angeles by U.S. News & World Report and named to the national Best Hospitals Honor Roll for 37 consecutive years, UCLA Health offers physicians the opportunity to build lasting patient relationships while serving diverse communities throughout West Los Angeles.
We are seeking board-certified/board-eligible Family Medicine, Internal Medicine and Med-Peds physicians for opportunities throughout the region.
Discover opportunities throughout West Los Angeles and find the community that best fits your practice and lifestyle. Current openings include:
Community-based outpatient primary care with access to UCLA Health’s extensive network of specialists and clinical resources
Diverse patient populations across West Los Angeles communities
Staff Physician and Clinician Educator opportunities available based on qualifications, professional interests and practice needs
UCLA Health offers a comprehensive benefits program designed to support your health, well-being and future. Explore the comprehensive list of University of California benefits, here.

West Los Angeles offers a unique blend of vibrant neighborhoods, coastal communities, cultural attractions and year-round outdoor activities. From the beaches of Santa Monica and Malibu to the dining, arts and entertainment of Culver City and Century City, the Westside offers convenient access to communities including Brentwood, Beverly Hills, West Hollywood, Marina del Rey and Venice—making it an exceptional place to build both your practice and your life.
